items.title: Ellis Marsalis — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Geneva Southall wrote the book on Blind Tom. Geneva Southall was Antoinette’s sister.

ctx.x: I’m just trying to figure out – you mentioned about the woman who wrote the history of African-American music. I know Eileen Southern. I know Geneva Southall was also – but anyway . . .
Geneva Southall wrote the book on Blind Tom. Geneva Southall was Antoinette’s sister.
That’s it. I knew there was a connection. That’s it. Thank you.
